title: SPA/217/2013 of Smt Neema Mehra Vs State Of Uttarakhand AND OTHERS

paras.text:
IN THE HIGH COURT OF UTTARAKHAND AT NAINITAL
Special Appeal No. 217 of 2013
Smt. Neema Mehra .......Appellant

Versus
State of Uttarakhand and others. .......Respondents
Mr. Bhagwat Mehra, Advocate for the appellant.
Mr. K.P. Upadhyay, Chief Standing Counsel for the State of Uttarakhand / respondent
nos. 1 to 5.
Mr. Alok Dalakoti, Advocate holding brief of Mr. Pradeep Chamiyal, Advocate for
respondent no. 6.
Coram : Hon'ble Barin Ghosh, C. J.
Hon'ble Servesh Kumar Gupta, J.
Barin Ghosh, C.J. (Oral)

The preferential qualification in terms of the
advertisement was being a member of BPL category. Hema Devi
represented that she belongs to BPL category. Her candidature
was, accordingly, considered in BPL category. In order to satisfy
that she belongs to BPL category, she relied upon a certificate. The
same was sent for inquiry. On completion of the inquiry, it was
stated in the report that the copy of the certificate sent to the person
making the inquiry did not contain the name of the mother-in-law
of Hema Devi as the head of the family of Hema Devi. At the
same time, it was stated that there is an entry suggesting that Hema
Devi is a member of the family headed by her mother-in-law.
Unfortunately, nowhere it was stated, whether Hema Devi was or
was not a BPL category person. In other words, inquiry did not
address whether Hema Devi, in fact, is a person belonging to a
BPL family. It is also not known, if it was true that Hema Devi
belonged to BPL family, whether she would have been selected

2
instead of the appellant herein. In the circumstances, the selection
of appellant has been cancelled with a direction to readvertise. By
the judgment under Appeal, the said order has been retained with
only a modification that until such time the selection of the proper
candidate is made, appellant will continue to discharge the duties
of Angan Bari worker.
 2. We are not inclined to interfere. The Appeal fails and
the same is dismissed.

(Servesh Kumar Gupta, J.) (Barin Ghosh, C.J.)
 10.07.2013 10.07.2013
Rathour
